operations.name: mask.add
operations.description: Add a raster mask to the active layer. mode "selection" rasterizes the current selection (selected = visible); default is "selection" when one exists, else "reveal".

operations.name: mask.apply
operations.description: Apply the active raster layer mask into pixel alpha, then remove the mask. Undoable.

operations.name: mask.from_transparency
operations.description: Create a layer mask from the active raster layer alpha and make nontransparent source pixels opaque. Undoable.

operations.name: mask.remove
operations.description: Delete the active layer’s mask (the layer becomes fully visible again).

operations.name: mask.set_target
operations.description: Choose what paint.stroke edits on the active layer: its pixels (edit_mask=false) or its mask (edit_mask=true; paint black to hide, white to reveal).
